::: {#exm-palindrome-recursive}
#### `pal` is recursive

The algorithm `pal` of @exr-palindrome-trace is recursive (@def-recursive-algorithm).
On a string of $n \ge 2$ symbols whose first and last symbols match,
it calls itself on the string without those two symbols, which has $n - 2$ symbols,
and returns what that call returns.

It answers directly in two cases:
when $n \le 1$, since the empty string and a single symbol read the same backward,
and when the first and last symbols differ.
For example, `pal(recur)` finds that the first and last symbols are both `r`, and calls `pal(ecu)`.
That call finds `e` and `u`, which differ, and returns false,
so `pal(recur)` returns false.

:::
